responsibility: Defines the gm2 compiler’s global option state and its setter/getter API. It centralizes language dialect flags, semantic checks, optimization and debugging switches, preprocessing controls, path and extension options, save-temps and dump settings, runtime-module overrides, scaffold generation, and cpp command-line capture, making it the authoritative interface for front-end option policy used across parsing, diagnostics, and code generation.
same_name_distinction: Definition module for the M2Options pair: it is the published option contract, exporting the global option variables plus the large setter/getter API used across the front end, while `gcc/m2/gm2-compiler/M2Options.mod` stores values, updates strings/paths, and derives final option state.
